author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Creates Twitch clips from !clip and optionally publishes other clips made during the observed current stream to a Discord channel or forum chosen from your Discord webhooks.
changelog: 4.1.5: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.5, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: added a Twitch-only !clip creation path, 30/60-second duration control, direct created-clip relay, and strict current-stream timestamp filtering for optional discovery. Older library clips no longer qualify. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge baseline. 2.4.2: initial stable-ID Discord delivery release.

manifest.name: Clip Courier

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Clip Courier - Create Clip

installationSteps: Import the matching Clip Courier Streamer.bot package. Leave Create Clip triggerless.
Open Create Clip and set clipCourierDurationSeconds to 30 or 60. Approve Create Clip in the wizard; StreamBridge calls it only for an authorized Twitch !clip intake command.
Add the Discord webhook for your clip channel or forum under Platforms > Discord webhooks, then choose it in Clip Courier settings.
The command-created clip returns directly to Clip Courier; automatic background discovery uses the shared Clip Library Cache.
Disable any legacy Streamer.bot !clip Command object before testing so the main Twitch intake is the only command owner.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded publication history remains preserved.

healthChecks.description: Confirms command clip creation, current-stream filtering, and idempotent Discord publication are available.
